notes: Vocabulary gap in who_found_it: the fixed list (parent-inline / post-admission-audit / human-manual-QA / caught-by-a-sibling-leafs-test / never-caught-surfaced-later) has no clean category for the corpus's single most common pattern - a leaf discovering, via its own TDD RED/GREEN cycle on its own assigned test, that the parent-authored test (not its own implementation) is wrong. This occurred independently in switchboard (sprint-1.10/leaf-B), ouroboros (leaf-04/beats.json, leaf-02/leaf-05 harness race), ouroboros-manifold (tier1/leaf-02), and LeadLine (posture/leaf-03) - four separate projects. It was mapped here to 'caught-by-a-sibling-leafs-test' as the closest available option, but it is technically the SAME leaf's test catching a bug in a test IT was handed, not a literal sibling leaf's test catching a shared bug. Recommend either renaming this category or adding a sixth option (e.g. 'caught-by-the-leafs-own-assigned-test') in a future version of the who_found_it vocabulary.

Category vocabulary gap: no existing category in CATEGORY_VOCAB.md cleanly fits build-time process violations (staging-directory bypass, undisclosed scope expansion) or test-harness timing/race defects (Godot SceneTree cross-process quirks) - both were filed under 'other'. These recur multiple times in this corpus (switchboard wave-4, ouroboros leaf-11, ouroboros leaf-02/leaf-05) and might warrant a dedicated category (e.g. 'staging-integrity-breach' or 'harness-timing-defect') if this vocabulary is extended.
